description: This file defines a class Log responsible for logging messages to a file within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for constructing a log object with a filename and writing messages to the specified log file.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A class for logging messages to a specified file within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Log object, creating the log file if it does not already exist.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a message to the log file with a timestamp.
